# 🏆 LinkedIn Jobs Scraper

The Apify actor [`valig/linkedin-jobs-scraper`](https://apify.com/valig/linkedin-jobs-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.21**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

$0.4/1K jobs | Scrape LinkedIn job listings based on your selected role and location, saving you time and effort.

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.0004, Actor Start $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/valig/linkedin-jobs-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/valig-linkedin-jobs-scraper@0.0.21#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keywords` | string |  |  | Search keywords — Search by title, skill, or company |
| `location` | string |  |  | Job location — City, state, or zip code |
| `datePosted` | string |  |  | Date posted — Filter by age of the job posting |
| `companyName` | array |  |  | Company name — Filter by company name |
| `companyId` | array |  |  | Company id — Filter by company ID |
| `easyApply` | boolean |  |  | Easy Apply — Only include jobs with the Easy Apply option |
| `under10Applicants` | boolean |  |  | Under 10 applicants — Only include jobs with Under 10 applicants |
| `limit` | integer |  | `100` | Results limit — Maximum results count |
| `urlPath` | string |  |  | URL Path — Custom job search path. Must start with /jobs/ (e.g., /jobs/search). |
| `urlParam` | array |  |  | URL Param — Pass additional URL parameters to the search request |
| `skipJobId` | array |  |  | Skip job ID — Filter out specific job IDs from results |
| `titleInclude` | array |  |  | Title include — Only include jobs whose title contains all words from at least one of these phrases (case insensitive, word order does not matter). |
| `titleExclude` | array |  |  | Title exclude — Exclude jobs whose title contains all words from at least one of these phrases (case insensitive, word order does not matter). |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
